description: Live run-time state of one chain's node. When to use: is this chain's node synced, healthy or lagging; what is its height, peer count, mempool depth or client version. Do not use: fees (that is btc_get_fee_rates); a specific payment (that is btc_get_transaction); ZEC pool distribution (that is zec_get_pool_status). Returns: chain, ok, synced, height, peers, mempool, client, state; a chain that is not live yet returns served=false plus its tier instead of an error.

chain.description: Chain id: btc / eth / xmr / zec / base / sol / tron
